comparison.objective: Use a scoop to deliver clean ice to a bowl without cross-contamination.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid opening, scooping discrete cubes, containment during transport, pouring/release, and hygiene-aware source selection.
comparison.success_condition: At least one clean-source cube delivered by the scoop, settled and released, with lid history and no contamination; fish-source, hand-carried, or dirty-scoop delivery loses full credit. Cube loss outside the bowl is not fully quantified.
comparison.reason: This tests hygienic source selection and scoop delivery. It lacks aperture-based separation, orientation-dependent passage, bridging, and mandatory retention of larger workpieces.
